name: construct3-minigame-adapter
description: Construct 3 addon, runtime adapter and experimental WeChat/Douyin/TikTok mini-game build tools

scripts.export:wechat: node src/cli.mjs convert --input examples/construct/api-demo-html5 --output dist/construct-wechat --platform wechat --experimental --overwrite
scripts.export:douyin: node src/cli.mjs convert --input examples/construct/api-demo-html5 --output dist/construct-douyin --platform douyin --experimental --overwrite
scripts.export:tiktok: node src/cli.mjs convert --input examples/construct/api-demo-html5 --output dist/construct-tiktok --platform tiktok --experimental --overwrite
scripts.build: npm run build:addon && npm run build:demo
